upright.affirmation: You don't need a sign. Try it.
upright.reading:
The Fool carries the pure power of departure - embarking on every unknown journey without presuppositions or asking for results. At this moment, you stand at a new starting point.

Maybe think, "How about giving it a try," or you may become suddenly curious about something. Now is the time to sign up for that course you've always wanted to take, connect with that new friend, and try a different route home. Skip repeated trade-offs.

Embrace the uncertainty. The road is made, and you are ready.
questions: What’s something I’ve always wanted to do but haven’t?
What will this new beginning bring?
Is now the right time to take the first step?

reversed.affirmation: Pause. Then decide.
reversed.reading:
As soon as you step out, the uneasiness in your heart is already holding you back.

This uneasiness makes sense. Why not stop and ask yourself today: Am I chasing my dreams or escaping reality? Am I really ready, or is it just anxiety that makes me feel like "I have to do something"? Don’t act blindly because you’re afraid of missing out, or lose your opinion because you listen to too many external voices.

Give yourself some time. True courage is not about being impulsive, but about knowing why you are doing it.
questions: Is my current behavior just hot-headed?
Is action now courageous or evasive?
Are the promises he made just trying to spread the pie?

upright.affirmation: You have more solutions than you think
upright.reading:
The magician's energy is the convergence of will and action - he knows how to transform everything at hand into the power of creation. At this moment, the resources you need are already at hand.

Maybe find that something you have always wanted to do suddenly has a clear direction; or you may realize that you are actually more capable than you thought. Today, integrate the resources at hand and start taking action, take the initiative to present your ideas or works, and turn your plan into the first step. Skip feeling "not good enough" enough to start, or waiting for outside permission to act.

Believe in your abilities. You already have the power to create.
questions: What resources are available to me?
Which of my ideas can I start putting into action?
Is the charm shown by him or her just trying to trick me?

reversed.affirmation: Being real is enough.
reversed.reading:
The more you try to package yourself as impeccable, the easier it will be to show your cowardice. Right now you want to show a less authentic version of yourself, or use techniques to cover up certain uncertainties.

It is better to honestly look at the boundaries of your own capabilities, admit "I don't know" or "I need help", and face others with authenticity instead of pretense. Don't over-package yourself, manipulate others to achieve your goals, or use your wisdom in the wrong place.

Sincerity is more powerful than skill. When you let go of the pretense, the real magic emerges.
questions: Is what he says worthy of my trust?
Am I avoiding real issues?
Am I wasting my time in an unreliable relationship?

upright.affirmation: Listen inward.
upright.reading:
The Priestess guards the silent place within - that depth that requires no words, only listening. Right now, your inner wisdom is waiting for you to come closer.

Maybe feel some subtle intuition—that something "feels wrong" or that a certain direction "just feels right", although you can't tell why. This is a good time to spend time alone, journal or meditate, and trust those feelings of "you can't tell but you just know." Skip overreliance on outside opinions, rushing to find answers, or using reason over intuition.

The answer is not outside, but inside you. Give it some quiet space and it will emerge.
questions: Why do I feel something is wrong?
If he doesn't speak now, should I stay put?
How long will the tacit ambiguity continue?

reversed.affirmation: Make room for quiet.
reversed.reading:
When your phone is filled with other people’s voices, it’s easy for your own thoughts to get pushed to the back. You can't hear your true feelings, or your inner voice is drowned out by too much external information.

This kind of state is not strange, but don’t soak yourself in the noise all the time. You can start with these small things: reduce your information intake, turn off social media for a while, and ask yourself "what do I really want" instead of "what should I want". Be careful not to numb yourself with busyness, rely too much on divination or other people's opinions, or avoid being alone because you are afraid of facing the truth.

Rediscover the ability to talk to yourself. The inner wisdom is always there, it just needs you to calm down.
questions: Am I thinking too much?
How long will TA's deliberate dodge last?
Am I kidding myself?

upright.affirmation: You deserve to live a more comfortable life
upright.reading:
The Queen represents the energy of abundance, creation and nourishment - all things grow naturally under her care. You are also surrounded by this energy at this moment.

Maybe feel an urge to create, care for others, or express beauty. This is a good time to do things that make you feel good, take care of your body's needs (eat well, rest), or treat yourself and others with gentleness. Skip over-paying and neglecting yourself, feeling that "enjoyment" is a waste of time, or applying harsh standards to yourself.

Allow yourself to receive abundance. You deserve to be treated with tenderness and you deserve to enjoy the beauty of life.
questions: How should I be gentle with myself?
In his/her eyes, am I very attractive?
How should I fully enjoy the nourishment of this relationship?

reversed.affirmation: Before taking care of others, take care of yourself
reversed.reading:
People who worry about others for too long often forget to ask themselves if they are tired. In this matter, you are overpaying and busy taking care of others, but you forget to give yourself some tenderness.

First admit that you are tired, and then schedule in taking care of yourself. This is a better time to ask yourself "what do I really need?", say no to unnecessary efforts, or simply give yourself some time to relax. You don’t have to feel guilty about forcing yourself to give, feel like it’s selfish to take care of yourself, or use “I’m okay” to avoid the real exhaustion.

Keep some love to yourself. Only by taking care of yourself can you truly nourish others.
questions: Will my condition be better if I no longer revolve around him?
What does my inner child want to say to me?
Does my concern and dedication make him feel that he deserves it?

upright.affirmation: You can make your arrangements clear
upright.reading:
The Emperor symbolizes order, control, and the energy that creates structure—he knows how to create his own law out of chaos. You need to be in control of your life right now.

Maybe feel the need to set some rules, clear up a mess, or say "no" to something. This is a good time to set clear boundaries, organize plans or circumstances, and develop concrete steps toward goals. Skip being overly controlling and losing your flexibility, doing nothing for fear of losing control, or allowing others to encroach on your boundaries.

Be your own master. You have the right to decide your own rules and the ability to establish your own order.
questions: Where do I need to establish clearer boundaries?
What things need me to take back control?
Does his current behavior mean that he wants to confirm our relationship?

reversed.affirmation: A detour isn't failure.
reversed.reading:
If you hold your hands too tightly, things you could do well will become awkward. Judging from the reaction, you are too strict with yourself or others, or you become rigid because you are afraid of losing control.

There is no need to tighten yourself in order to gain a sense of security. Today you can start by asking yourself, "What am I afraid of?", letting go of unnecessary rules, or allowing things to not go as planned. Stop using authority to overwhelm others, dehumanizing others in the pursuit of perfection, or relying on control as your only source of security.

Try to relax a little. If you relax a little, you will be able to see the next step more clearly.
questions: Is he/she acting too selfish towards me?
Am I too stubborn and too strict with myself?
Am I showing weakness to make him or her feel in control?

upright.affirmation: It doesn’t matter if you don’t understand, just ask.
upright.reading:
The Pope symbolizes tradition, teaching, and energy seeking guidance—he is the bridge between individual and collective wisdom. At this point, you may need some outside wisdom.

Maybe want to seek advice from a mentor, learn about a field, or seek answers from traditional wisdom. This is a good time to seek advice from experienced people, attend courses or workshops, or research proven methods. Skip blindly following authority, losing your own thinking, or being rebellious and rejecting all outside guidance.

Stay open and humble. The wisdom of predecessors can save you a lot of detours.
questions: Who can I learn from or ask for advice?
Is this kind of regular relationship suitable for me?
By following this mentor, will I be sure to get the results?

reversed.affirmation: What others do may not suit you
reversed.reading:
The statement "everyone is like this" may not make your decision for you.

Doubting old rules shows that you are already forming your own judgment. Try to re-examine yourself first, explore unconventional methods, or allow yourself to take a different path.

Trust your own path. Sometimes true freedom is found in breaking the rules.
questions: What rules do I need to break?
Will my life script be more exciting if I think outside the box?
What is the best development path for me?

upright.affirmation: Choose what feels true.
upright.reading:
The Lovers card symbolizes choice, connection, and alignment of values—true connection comes from harmony within and without. At this moment, you may be faced with an important choice.

Maybe need to decide between two options or realize whether a relationship truly aligns with your values. This is a good time to honestly ask yourself, "Is this really what I want?", choose a direction consistent with your heart, or express your true self in a relationship. Skip going against yourself to please others, procrastinating because of fear of choice, or ignoring differences in values ​​because of passion.

Choose your true self. The best connections come from alignment inside and out.
questions: Is he really the 'right person'?
Faced with two options, what do I desire most?
Should I take the initiative to give him or her a signal?

reversed.affirmation: A relationship shouldn't be supported by you alone
reversed.reading:
If some words are left unsaid, the awkwardness in the relationship will accumulate. Your values ​​may no longer align with someone's, or you may realize you're not being authentic in a relationship.

It's more useful to talk about the stuck areas in the relationship than to keep guessing. Give yourself some time to honestly assess the current state of the relationship, ask yourself "Am I compromising too much," or face the differences that exist between you and your partner? Remember not to suppress your true feelings in order to maintain superficial harmony, stay in the wrong relationship because you are afraid of being alone, or use self-deception to avoid making choices.

Honor your inner insecurities. Sometimes, disharmony is a reminder to make a new choice.
questions: Is it necessary for the two of us to continue to get along?
Is it because I am distracted and tired of studying because I simply don’t like this major?
Are there truths in this relationship that I’m afraid to face?

upright.affirmation: Once you set the direction, you can get there slowly.
upright.reading:
The chariot symbolizes willpower, control and forward energy - he knows how to integrate inner contradictions and focus his power forward. At this moment, you need to concentrate your efforts and move towards your goal.

Maybe feel a strong sense of motivation or a need to find balance among conflicts. This is a good time to focus on what matters most, move forward despite obstacles, or integrate disparate ideas into a unified direction. Skip using brute force instead of wisdom, being led by emotions and losing direction, or being afraid to act out of fear of failure.

Keep your hands on the wheel. You have the ability to control it all, and the road ahead is waiting for you to conquer.
questions: How do I stay focused in the face of career obstacles?
Do you want to use all your energy to defeat him?
In the final sprint before the exam, can I break out of the siege?

reversed.affirmation: Check the direction first.
reversed.reading:
If the steering wheel is messed up, no matter how much you press the accelerator, it will only make you more panicked. My mind is actually pulling in different directions, or I feel like I am being pushed by external forces instead of actively moving forward.

Next, ask yourself "Do I really want to go in this direction?", re-evaluate whether the goal is correct, or admit "I need to rest now." Don’t keep pushing forward, masking a sense of loss with busyness, or refusing to rethink because you’re afraid to stop.

Stopping does not mean giving up, but to find the true direction. Only you know where you should go.
questions: Am I a little pushy?
In this relationship, am I immersed in my own self-movation?
Is my current learning style reasonable?

upright.affirmation: You can be gentle, or you can be firm
upright.reading:
The energy of the Strength card is not to conquer, but to tame - to resolve confrontation with gentleness and patience, this is true strength. You have this power right now.

Maybe encounter some challenges or conflicts, but you have the ability to resolve them with gentleness rather than violence. This is a good time to face difficulties with patience, express your position gently, or solve problems with understanding rather than confrontation. Skip using force to suppress others or yourself, losing your mind because of anger, or thinking that gentleness is weakness.

True strength comes from gentleness. You can be firm and still be soft at the same time.
questions: How to control this relationship with gentleness and confidence?
Is it time to use softness to overcome hardness to resolve conflicts?
In the face of fear, how to mobilize the inner courage to overcome it?

reversed.affirmation: It’s normal to be afraid, don’t rush to prove yourself
reversed.reading:
Everyone will have moments when they feel unsure, so there is no need to rush to pretend that nothing is wrong. Things like: You're doubting yourself, feeling weak, or overwhelmed by fear.

Just because you don't have the confidence right now doesn't mean you really can't do it. Instead of trying to figure it all out now, start by being gentle with your vulnerability, admitting, "I'm scared right now," or asking for support from others. Stop blaming yourself for showing weakness, masking your inner fears with toughness, or refusing to admit that you need help.

Admitting you are afraid won't make you worse; it will help you stabilize.
questions: Is my dominance pushing the people I like away?
Do I have fears deep inside?
How to calm down anxiety before exams?

upright.affirmation: Your own company counts.
upright.reading:
The hermit holds the inner light and walks alone - his loneliness is not an escape, but a journey inward to find the light. At this moment, you also need this kind of solitude.

Maybe feel a need to get away, to be alone with your thoughts, or to long for some answers. This is a good time to be alone, think deeply about an important issue, or explore your heart inwardly. Skip using social interactions to avoid being alone, being afraid of facing yourself in silence, or feeling anxious about being alone.

Solitude is a gift. In silence, you will find your own light.
questions: Can cold treatment help me see the other person's sincerity clearly?
If I take the initiative to cut off contact, will he/she wake up?
How do I find my sober self in this relationship?

reversed.affirmation: Say it out loud.
reversed.reading:
When the door is closed for too long, it becomes a little difficult to even find someone to talk to. Your reaction is: you are escaping from the outside world, refusing to connect with others, or being trapped in your own world and unable to get out.

Try opening the door a crack so people can get closer to you. Pick one thing to do first: reach out to others, step out of your comfort zone, or admit "I need help from the outside world." There’s no need to punish yourself with loneliness, refuse connection because you’re afraid of getting hurt, or feel like alone time is the only right thing.

Get outside a little. Light is not only in your heart, but also in your connections with others.
questions: Am I isolating myself too much?
Is the endless cold war solving problems or escaping?
If I keep holding back and not communicating, will this relationship come to an end?

upright.affirmation: When you encounter changes, you can embrace new possibilities
upright.reading:
The wheel of fortune is constantly spinning, symbolizing cycles, changes and transitions - each spin is a new possibility. Right now, you are at a turning point and something is changing.

You might encounter an unexpected opportunity, feel a shift happening, or realize that things are moving in a good direction. This is a good time to stay open, seize opportunities that present themselves, or trust that things will work out naturally. Skip resisting because of fear of change, over-controlling desired results, or missing out on opportunities because of anxiety.

Believe in the arrangement of the universe. The wheel is turning, you just have to go with the energy.
questions: How should I accurately grasp this reunion?
My relationship suddenly heats up, how do I guide it toward stability?
How can I maximize my strengths?

reversed.affirmation: When things don’t go your way, steady your steps first
reversed.reading:
When things go wrong one after another, it's easy to blame oneself for bad luck. At this moment, you feel like you have bad luck and things always go wrong.

Lows will change and will not define your future. If you still don’t know what to do, wait patiently for the opportunity or learn from setbacks. Don’t let anxiety force you to blame fate, give up on all your efforts, or deny yourself because of a momentary failure.

Remember: the lows won’t last forever, as long as you keep moving forward, the highs will come again.
questions: No matter how hard you try, there is no progress. Is your fate exhausted?
Are these sudden little accidents reminding me of something?
My fortune has been average recently, how should I resolve it?

upright.affirmation: Before rushing to judge, listen to both sides.
upright.reading:
Justice symbolizes fairness, truth, and cause and effect—she is impartial and sees things as they are. At this moment, you need to face things with fairness.

Maybe need to make an important decision, face a truth, or realize that "you will reap what you sow." This is a good time to objectively assess a situation, accept your own responsibilities, or treat others and yourself fairly. Skip making biased judgments, avoiding responsibilities, or deceiving yourself out of fear of the truth.

Honesty and fairness will bring you true balance. The truth may be uncomfortable, but it is the beginning of freedom.
questions: Rational analysis, is he still worthy of my investment?
How can I end the current Cold War with dignity?
Do my current results reflect my true efforts?

reversed.affirmation: Name what hurt.
reversed.reading:
I clearly felt something was wrong, but I couldn't explain why it was unfair. It's not hard to find a situation where you feel like you didn't get what you deserve, or that someone is avoiding their responsibilities.

First admit that this matter makes you feel wronged, and then you will know how to respond. The first thing you can do is be honest about how you feel, without falling into a victim mentality, using injustice as an excuse for not trying harder, or losing your mind out of anger.

True justice sometimes takes time. Find inner balance first, and external fairness will slowly come.
questions: Is the unfairness I feel real?
Am I too soft-hearted, causing the balance of this relationship to completely tilt?
Is the best option at this moment to stop losses in time?

upright.affirmation: Pause. Shift perspective.
upright.reading:
The calmness of The Hanged Man comes from complete letting go - from another perspective, the world looks completely different. At this moment, you need to stop and look at things from a different perspective.

Maybe feel that something needs to be paused, that you need to let go of certain obsessions, or that you may realize that "maybe I've been looking at it wrong all along." This is a good time to stop struggling, accept that "now is not the time to act," or rethink the problem from a different perspective. Skip pushing forward out of fear of wasting time, refusing to let go, or feeling that pausing is a failure.

Letting go is not giving up, but to see more clearly. Sometimes, you have to look at the world backwards to see the truth.
questions: How long do I have to wait for things to turn around?
My career is stagnant, should I continue my studies?
How do I let go of the obsession of 'must win'?

reversed.affirmation: Ask what you fear.
reversed.reading:
I keep saying "wait a little longer" for a long time, sometimes just because I don't dare to go down. In the past few days, you have been using waiting as an excuse for not taking action, or you have been stuck in hesitation for too long.

There won't be an automatic answer if you wait any longer. Today, ask yourself "What am I waiting for?" Acknowledge the fear behind procrastination, or take the first step. Don't rush to continue to use "the time is not yet" to avoid, do nothing for fear of making the wrong choice, or glorify procrastination into wisdom.

Some waiting is necessary, but some waiting is just fear. Distinguish them and act.
questions: Am I biding my time or procrastinating?
Should this kind of unrequited self-impression be stopped?
Did my concession result in TA getting tougher?

upright.affirmation: Putting down inappropriate things is making room for yourself
upright.reading:
The Death card symbolizes endings, transformation and rebirth - it is never an end, but rather the entrance to the next part of the journey. Something is leaving your life at this moment, but it is necessary.

Maybe be experiencing the end of a relationship, the end of a phase, or realizing that an "older self" needs to die. Today, take the initiative to clean up what you don't need, say a symbolic farewell, or accept that "this ending is for a better beginning." Skip resisting change, holding on to things you shouldn’t, or refusing to let go out of fear of losing.

Allow closure to happen. Just like the leaves in autumn must fall before the new shoots in spring can grow.
questions: How do I end this relationship gracefully and move on?
How can I change the part of my personality that is causing me pain?
What new beginning will this ending bring?

reversed.affirmation: Dragging it out drains you.
reversed.reading:
Things that you know you should turn over are still at the bottom of your heart. Right now you are holding on to something you should be letting go of, or refusing to accept an ending.

The more you suppress the past, the more it will take up your strength. It's better to honestly ask yourself "what am I afraid of losing" and admit "maybe it's time". Don't use procrastination to avoid change, cling to it out of fear, or feel that letting go is a betrayal.

Resistance will not prevent change, it will only make you more miserable. Only by letting go a little will there be room for change to really happen.
questions: Am I afraid to end the relationship because I'm afraid of being alone?
Will repeated pulling make my injury worse?
What kind of unwillingness is preventing me from starting a new life?
dos: Change new sheets and quilt covers
donts: Recalling the details of my relationship with my ex
The room is too messy and cannot be tidied up

upright.affirmation: Don’t go to extremes, give yourself some room
upright.reading:
Temperance symbolizes balance, harmony, and patience—true wisdom is finding the flowing middle between opposites. At this point, you need to find the middle path.

Maybe be faced with a choice between two extremes, feel the need to integrate disparate parts, or realize that the "middle" is the answer. This is a good time to find balance among opposites, wait patiently for things to unfold naturally, or gently reconcile disparate voices. Skip going to extremes, rushing for quick results, or compromising too much out of fear of conflict.

True wisdom lies in balance. It’s not about black and white, it’s about finding your own gray area.
questions: How can I resolve the gap between us through efficient communication?
How to find the freshness of love in the dullness of the flowing water?
How do I balance work and life?

reversed.affirmation: After the rhythm is messed up, slowly adjust it back
reversed.reading:
On the one hand, I think I am too tired, but on the other hand, I cannot stop. This kind of pulling is very consuming. This is a time when you are overdoing it in some way, feeling out of control in your life, or finding yourself swinging between two extremes.

Reduce the excess and the rhythm will gradually stabilize. It can start with the little things: reevaluating priorities, cutting back on excess, or admitting, "I need to slow down." Be careful not to continue to go to extremes, to balance imbalances with more imbalances, or to refuse to admit that you have gone too far.

Find your center again. True balance requires honestly seeing where things are out of balance.
questions: How can I find a sense of balance in a relationship that is hot and cold?
Am I giving too much and causing the relationship to become completely unbalanced?
How should I adjust my current imbalanced economic situation?
dos: Don’t look at your phone twenty minutes before going to bed
donts: Too busy to forget to drink water

upright.affirmation: You can stay away from things that make you uncomfortable
upright.reading:
The truth revealed by the Devil card is that the shackles that bind us are often much looser than we think. At this moment, you need to see clearly what is binding you.

Maybe realize that a habit, a relationship, or a belief is limiting you, but you never see it. This is a good time to honestly admit, "I'm stuck," see an obsession for what it is, or realize, "I can actually leave." Skip continuing to lie to yourself, masking unhealthy health with happiness, or remaining in bondage because of fear of change.

Seeing the truth is the beginning of freedom. The chains are always loose and you can leave at any time.
questions: Am I in the midst of a painful and unbreakable 'sadistic love'?
Does he/she really like me, or is he attracted to me physically/materially?
Am I being controlled by an addictive habit that is causing my life to become stagnant?
dos: Take a half-hour walk after a meal
donts: Stay up late binge watching TV shows
Milk tea snacks full of sugar

reversed.affirmation: You let go. Stay free.
reversed.reading:
The rope that was too tight was starting to loosen a little. In this case, you're breaking a bad habit, leaving an unhealthy relationship, or realizing I don't need this anymore.

Being able to realize "I don't need this anymore" is a key step to getting out of the cycle. Now is the time to continue this liberating process, seek support to help you break the cycle, or celebrate every small step forward. Try not to give up halfway because you think “enough is enough,” underestimate the difficulty of breaking free, or give up after one failure.

Even if it happens again and again, put your attention back to what you can do today.
questions: Now that I have seen his true colors, should I completely block him and cut off contact with him?
How do I get back to my true self from this controlling relationship?
Which emotion is the shadow that I need to clean up and face the most?
dos: Eat fried chicken with honey mustard sauce
donts: Repeatedly click on your ex’s avatar

upright.affirmation: You can fix this.
upright.reading:
The tower symbolizes sudden collapse, the revelation of truth, and radical change—only structures built on lies can collapse. At this point, something may snap, but it's necessary.

Maybe face a sudden change, a certain truth suddenly emerges, or realize that "it turned out to be an illusion all along." This is a time to accept that the old must fall, to remain calm in the midst of chaos, or to believe that the fall must lead to a truer rebuilding. Skip denying what is happening, fighting change with anger, or trying to recreate the way it was out of fear.

Let it collapse. Only a tower built on lies will fall, and the foundation of truth will remain.
questions: Faced with this quarrel, should I let it go?
What truth is this argument trying to tell me?
How should I maintain inner stability in the face of sudden changes?

reversed.affirmation: It's not hard to admit it when you know it's wrong
reversed.reading:
On the surface it looked fine, but in my heart I knew I was about to lose my strength. From your reaction, you know something is not right, but you are trying to maintain a semblance of stability.

Continuing to drag it will only make the crack more difficult to repair. Today you can start by asking yourself "What am I afraid of collapsing", admitting "maybe it's time to face it", or take the initiative to dismantle the unstable parts. Stop pretending everything is okay, covering the cracks with more lies, or resisting change out of fear.

It is better to face it proactively than to bear it passively. Instead of waiting for it to collapse, take the initiative to rebuild it.
questions: What relationship or situation am I trying to hold on to that is destined to disintegrate?
How should I heal my broken emotions after that huge conflict?
Have I been hiding in a crumbling building because I am afraid of change?
donts: Take the initiative to take work
Emotions bottled up in my heart

upright.affirmation: When you are down, don’t speak too poorly of yourself
upright.reading:
The star symbolizes hope, healing and guidance - shining steadily even after the deepest darkness. At this moment, hope is coming back into your life.

Maybe feel a certain lightness, see a direction ahead, or believe that "things will get better." This is a good time to believe in a better future, take time to heal yourself, or follow your inner guidance. Skip being held back by past trauma, feeling that hope is childish, or refusing to accept healing.

Give yourself permission to believe. After the darkest night, the stars will still shine.
questions: How can I open up to this feeling after experiencing previous pain?
Should I try to grasp this long-lost heartbeat?
Now that the direction is clear, how do I stay focused?

reversed.affirmation: When you feel bored, allow yourself to take a break
reversed.reading:
When you speak poorly of yourself, you can't even feel a little happy. In life, you feel lost, have no direction, or feel that things will never get better again.

Don't be too quick to criticize yourself. Disappointment is just a feeling right now. First try to admit "I'm desperate right now", seek the company of others, or do a small thing to take care of yourself. There is no need to pretend to be strong, give up all efforts out of despair, or reject any possible hope.

Hopefully it won't come back all at once, but it will come back slowly. Give yourself some time, the stars are still there, just temporarily obscured by dark clouds.
questions: Do I think the other person is too perfect?
How can I adjust my excessive expectations and prevent myself from getting hurt?
How can I achieve my goals through practical actions?
dos: drink hot milk before going to bed

upright.affirmation: When anxiety arises, don’t be too quick to believe it
upright.reading:
The moon symbolizes uncertainty, intuition, and the subconscious—the fog is not an obstacle but an invitation to look within. At this point, you may be feeling a little confused, but that's normal.

Maybe feel confused, have strange dreams, or feel like "something isn't quite right but you can't quite put your finger on it." This is a good time to trust intuition over logic, accept "it's not clear yet," or explore subconscious signals. Skip giving up because you can’t see clearly, over-rationalizing and ignoring feelings, or letting fear amplify uncertainty.

Moving forward in the fog requires intuition. The road is ahead, but you can't see it temporarily, but you know the direction inside.
questions: Are my insecurities and doubts because there is something really wrong with him or her?
How should I find an exit when faced with an ambiguity that is both invisible and intangible?
How should I face those negative emotions that I have suppressed for a long time?

reversed.affirmation: Once you see things clearly, you will feel more relaxed
reversed.reading:
After detouring for a long time, I finally felt like I could see the exit. Slowly, you will suddenly see something clearly, the previous confusion will begin to have answers, or you will realize that it is me who thinks too much.

If we can clarify the confusion a little bit, there will be a way forward. Give yourself some time first to sort out the previously chaotic thoughts, transform your intuition into clear cognition, or admit that "some fears are created by myself." Remember not to doubt yourself, refuse to accept the truth, or feel that the previous confusion was a waste of time after clarity.

Celebrate the arrival of clarity. The fog is part of the process, and now you can finally see the road.

This is a good time to make plans, evaluate different options, or seek a broader perspective. Skip becoming anxious about having too many choices, over-planning and not taking action, or fear of making the wrong choice.

Look bravely into the future. The world is big, and you have the power to explore it.
questions: Should I make long-term plans for this relationship?
Can TA and I overcome the current difficulties?
Which direction has more development prospects for me?

reversed.affirmation: When you are in trouble for a long time, give yourself a choice
reversed.reading:
There are more and more options, but I don’t know which one to take first. Right now you are stuck with too many choices, are afraid of making the wrong decision, or are waiting for a more certain signal.

Waiting for the "most certain signal" will only make the choice more difficult. It is better to first admit that "there is no perfect choice", trust your own judgment to make decisions, or accept "adjust as you go". Don’t continue to procrastinate, stop choosing anything out of fear, or leave the decision to someone else.

Making a choice is more important than a perfect choice. The road is made by walking on it, not by thinking about it.
questions: Am I too greedy to get into trouble?
Does the difference between us stem from the incompatibility of our plans?
Will my indecision cause me to miss out on opportunities?

Reply to a message with an emoticon
donts: Let others make decisions for you

upright.affirmation: You are qualified to visit the place you want to try.
upright.reading:
The Three of Wands symbolizes the view after sowing - the seed has been planted, what is needed now is patience and a broad perspective. At this moment, you need to look further.

Maybe see new opportunities, feel the need to branch out, or realize "it's time to get out there." This is a good time to explore new possibilities, connect with the outside world, or prepare for long-term goals. Skip being satisfied with the status quo, fearful of leaving your comfort zone, or anxious about not seeing immediate results.

Trust the seeds you sow. Harvest takes time, but the opportunity is already on the way.
questions: Should I give the other person more trust in this relationship?
Can the difficulties at hand deepen our bond?
Can this cooperation help me develop my career?
donts: Stay up late binge watching TV shows

reversed.affirmation: When there are too many things, you don’t have to hold on to every one of them.
reversed.reading:
Before I could stand firm on the matter in front of me, I already wanted to reach out further. During this period, you are chasing too many opportunities at the same time, wanting to expand before you are stable, or constantly looking for better ones out of anxiety.

Do this thing well and then think about the next step. You can start with the little things: coming back to the present moment, getting things done first, or admitting, "I need to stabilize the foundation first." Be careful not to continue to scatter your energy, want everything out of fear of missing out, or refuse to admit that you are overloaded.

Stability is more important than expansion. Only when your roots are deep can you grow taller.
questions: Are my expectations destined to be dashed?
Are my expectations for this relationship unrealistic?
Is there a gap between my execution and my goals?

upright.affirmation: When you encounter something happy, have fun with everyone
upright.reading:
The Four of Wands represents a time of celebration, stability and harmony - when hard work bears fruit, it is worth celebrating the completion of this phase. You deserve to be celebrated right now.

Maybe have completed a stage, achieved a small goal, or felt that your life was temporarily harmonious. This is a good time to celebrate your achievements, enjoy the beauty of the moment, or share happiness with the people who matter to you. Skip not celebrating because "it's not enough," jumping on to the next goal, or feeling like relaxing is a waste of time.

Give yourself permission to be happy. Celebration is not the end, but recharge for the next journey.
questions: Does this relationship require long-term planning?
How do I maintain this healing and warm relationship?
How to maintain the current sense of relaxation and security?

reversed.affirmation: When the atmosphere is awkward, just say less harsh words.
reversed.reading:
The place that is supposed to be relaxing has become a bit unsettling recently. In this case, you feel there is a lack of harmony in your life, no reason to celebrate, or tension with important people.

Start by saying what makes you uncomfortable. It is more worthwhile to ask yourself "what broke the harmony" at this time, take the initiative to repair the relationship, or create some sense of security for yourself. Having differences doesn't mean everything is broken. Don't drag the problem into a bigger knot.

Harmony can be re-established. Sometimes all it takes is a small adjustment.
questions: Are there cracks in our relationship?
Was everything I did just to look good?
Am I overly dependent on the group and losing my individual characteristics?

upright.affirmation: When you have different ideas, speak clearly
upright.reading:
The Five of Wands symbolizes conflict, competition, and the collision of different perspectives—friction is not always a bad thing, sometimes it is the doorway to growth. At this point, you may encounter some friction.

Maybe have disagreements with others, face competition, or feel that "everyone has a different opinion." This is a good time to express your opinions, be respectful in debates, or use competition as motivation for growth. Skip hurting relationships in order to win, avoiding conflict because of it, or thinking that disagreement is hostility.

Conflict is not necessarily a bad thing. Sometimes, collisions create new possibilities.
questions: What kind of charm should I use to attract him?
Does the endless bickering mean that we are not suitable?
How should I protect myself in the face of vicious competition in the workplace?
donts: Stay at home and lie down

reversed.affirmation: Don’t waste time on things that don’t yield results.
reversed.reading:
They argued one sentence after another, and in the end they even forgot why they started arguing. Judging from the reaction, you are fighting for the sake of fighting, getting into internal friction, or feeling that these arguments are meaningless.

It’s okay to stop arguing if it’s not worth it. Today you can start by asking yourself "What am I really fighting for?", choose not to participate in meaningless competition, or seek reconciliation. Stop getting involved in unnecessary fights, refusing to let go because of pride, or viewing all conflicts as wars that must be won.

Not all wars are worth fighting. Sometimes, letting go is more powerful than winning.
questions: How can I keep my emotions stable and not get involved in unnecessary disputes?
Am I in the middle of a pointless spat?
How to avoid unnecessary head-on conflicts in a smart and effortless way?

upright.affirmation: When you are praised, you can accept it calmly
upright.reading:
The Six of Wands symbolizes success, recognition, and public victory—when effort is seen, that affirmation brings real energy. At this moment, your efforts begin to be seen.

You might receive recognition, achieve a major milestone, or feel like you "finally made it." This is a good time to receive compliments, share your accomplishments, or celebrate your team. Skip rejecting recognition out of modesty, feeling like "it doesn't matter," or worrying about the pressure of success.

Allow yourself to enjoy the victory. You deserve this honor and your efforts deserve to be seen.
questions: How can I take my relationship to the next level?
How do I secure my position in the industry?
My grades are rising, how do I keep the momentum going?

reversed.affirmation: Just because recognition comes slowly doesn’t mean you can’t do it.
reversed.reading:
It’s easiest to start doubting yourself when your efforts are not seen. In life, you feel that your efforts are not seen, you are always being compared, or you doubt your own value.

It feels uncomfortable not being seen, but that doesn’t mean your efforts are worthless. First try to ask yourself, "Do I really need external recognition or internal affirmation?" Stop comparing yourself to others, or be proud of your own progress. Don’t always deny yourself because of lack of recognition, belittle yourself by using other people’s success, or be overly competitive for the sake of proof.

Others don’t applaud, and they don’t erase what you have done seriously.
questions: Am I overly reliant on outside approval?
TA's delay in making it public does this mean that she is treating me as a spare tire?
How can I relieve my anxiety about "moral incompetence" and build inner self-confidence?

upright.affirmation: You can keep the boundaries you care about well
upright.reading:
The Seven of Wands symbolizes firmness in defending one's position - knowing clearly where one stands in the face of doubt and pressure. At this point, you need to defend your position.

Maybe face challenges, need to protect your work, or feel "I have to stand firm." This is a good time to assert your boundaries firmly, stand up for something you believe in, or stay calm under pressure. Skip giving up your position out of fear of conflict, becoming overly defensive and aggressive, or feeling that standing up for yourself is selfish.

You have the right to protect what is yours. Being firm is not about attacking, but about respecting yourself.
questions: Do I have the courage to enter this relationship?
How do I assert my sovereignty in this relationship?
How do I keep the gains I've made?
donts: Humiliating oneself for the sake of being in the group

reversed.affirmation: Don’t treat everyone as an opponent
reversed.reading:
Treating every sentence as a challenge can be really tiring. Slowly, you see everyone as the enemy, get exhausted, or realize I'm guarding the wrong thing.

Think about whether this battle is really worth continuing. Give yourself some time to ask yourself "Is this really worth protecting?", let go of unnecessary fights, or admit "I need a break." Remember not to continue to consume yourself, refuse to let go because of pride, or treat every challenge as a battle that must be fought.

Not all battlefields are worth standing on. Choose what’s really important and let go of the rest.
questions: Should I end this relationship?
Is this relationship draining too much of my emotions and energy?
Does my character of not daring to refuse bring unnecessary fatigue to me?

upright.affirmation: When things go your way, just stay serious
upright.reading:
The Eight of Wands symbolizes rapid progress and the flow of energy – everything is accelerating and momentum has gathered. At the moment, things are moving quickly.

Maybe feel things suddenly speed up, receive good news, or find that "finally something is happening." Today, seize the momentum and push forward, respond quickly to opportunities, or just enjoy the flow. Skip being anxious about going too fast, wanting to control your speed, or slamming on the brakes out of fear.

Go with the flow. Sometimes, moving quickly is the best way to go.
questions: Will I hear a confession/long-awaited news recently?
Is our relationship moving too quickly?
How can I seize the moment of inspiration and realize it through execution?

reversed.affirmation: When the road is impassable, it doesn’t matter if you take a detour
reversed.reading:
Messages got stuck, plans were delayed, and the rhythm was completely disrupted. In fact, I encounter delays in my heart, feel that my energy is blocked, or find that something suddenly goes wrong.

Find the stuck link and decide how to deal with it. Next, identify the blockers, clean up the clutter, or admit, "This is not the time to sprint." Don’t get anxious because there is no progress, push forward and create more problems, or treat delays as failures.

Slowing down is not about regressing, but about moving forward more smoothly. Sometimes it is more effective to stop and clean up than to rush.
questions: Is he avoiding me?
Does this feeling 'come and go as quickly as it comes'?
Am I too concerned with speed that I'm overlooking some vulnerabilities?

upright.affirmation: No matter how tired you are, you have come a long way
upright.reading:
The Nine of Wands symbolizes perseverance in the face of exhaustion - remaining alert despite trials, knowing that the end is not far away. At this point, you may be feeling a little tired, but not completely relaxed yet.

Maybe have been through a lot and feel a little tired, but you still need to hold on a little longer. This is a good time to stay alert, guard your gains, or stay focused until the last minute. Skip giving up because you are tired, over-relaxing to the point of wasting all your efforts, or being overly nervous because of fear.

Hang in there. You have come so far, and you have to finish the last part of the journey well.
questions: Should I hold my line and wait for the other party to bow?
Should I remain aloof in the face of his temptation?
My goal is around the corner, how can I stabilize my mentality and not be overwhelmed by anxiety?

reversed.affirmation: When you are too tight, give yourself a break
reversed.reading:
People who have been holding on to that string dare not even relax completely when they take a break. The state is like: You are always tense and dare not relax, or you feel that I must always be ready.

You don’t need to think of every moment as a defensive battle. Don't rush to solve it all now. First admit "I'm tired", allow yourself to let down your guard, or believe that "you won't lose everything by relaxing temporarily." Don’t rush to continue to hold on, don’t dare to rest because of fear, or think that relaxing is weakness.

Taking a break will not cause you to lose what you have already secured.
questions: Am I overly nervous?
Am I pushing away a true relationship because I'm too afraid of getting hurt?
How do I fix the avoidance mentality caused by overexertion?
donts: Take the initiative to take work
Make up the plot in your mind before going to bed

upright.affirmation: You don't have to carry it all
upright.reading:
The Ten of Wands symbolizes moving forward with a heavy burden - the goal is in front of you, and you have to walk step by step even if the steps are heavy. At this point, you may be feeling a heavy responsibility.

Maybe have a lot of responsibilities, feel stressed, or realize "this is heavier than I thought." Today, evaluate what is necessary, ask for help to share some, or admit "I need support." Skip taking it all on because of a sense of responsibility, refusing help from others, or feeling that asking for help is a sign of weakness.

Responsibility is respected, but you don’t have to do it all yourself. Sharing is not escape, but wisdom.
questions: What responsibilities can I let go of or share with others?
Is my giving making me too exhausted in the relationship?
What burdens should I let go of?

reversed.affirmation: It's already good to take care of your own affairs.
reversed.reading:
Putting some weight away doesn't mean you're not good. Your response: You feel overwhelmed, realize it's not all my responsibility, or are ready to let go of some things.

It’s important to know that not everything should be done by yourself. Pick one thing to do first: let go of responsibilities that aren't yours, reassign tasks, or admit "I can't do them all." There is no need to carry on because of guilt, feeling that letting go is a failure, or worrying about what others will think.

Letting go is liberating. You don't need to prove how much you can carry, you just have to do what you can.
questions: Should I let go completely and return to freedom?
How to let go without feeling guilty?
What kind of life do I really want?
donts: Take the initiative to take work

upright.affirmation: It’s natural to ask when you don’t understand.
upright.reading:
The Page of Wands symbolizes curiosity, new information and the beginning of learning - he welcomes every unknown with childlike enthusiasm. In this moment, stay curious like a child.

You might become interested in something, hear exciting news, or want to learn something new. This is a good time to explore new areas, ask a lot of questions, or face things with a newbie's mentality. Skip being afraid to try because "I don't understand", worrying too much about failure, or feeling that exploration is a waste of time.

Curiosity is a gift. Every master was once a curious novice.
questions: Do you want to agree to his invitation?
Can I immerse myself in the freshness and energy of this new relationship?
How to maintain enthusiasm for learning?

reversed.affirmation: When you can't learn it, you can try another way.
reversed.reading:
The textbook is spread out in front of me, but I can't take it back. At this point, you’ve lost curiosity, found nothing interesting, or become frustrated and don’t want to continue.

When you can't learn it, another method is more effective than a hard top. If you still don't know what to do, ask yourself "what consumes my curiosity", study in a different way, or allow yourself to take a break. Don't let anxiety push you to push yourself to continue, give up completely due to burnout, or feel like "I just can't learn it."

Curiosity will come back. Sometimes you just need a change of perspective, or a break first.
questions: Should you treat a suitor coldly when you're only talking about him?
How to find the joy of learning again?
How do I turn unrealistic fantasies into workable plans?

upright.affirmation: When you have an idea, don’t just keep it in your mind
upright.reading:
The Knight of Wands symbolizes action, adventure and the pursuit of dreams - he moves forward at full speed with passion and leaves no room for hesitation. Now, it's time to act boldly.

Maybe feel a strong urge to take action immediately, or be ready for an adventure. Now is the time to follow your passion, take a bold step, or go all out with enthusiasm. Skip suppressing impulses out of fear, overthinking instead of acting, or worrying about what others will think.

Trust your passion. Sometimes bold action is the best option.
questions: How do I keep up with the other person and attract them?
How can execution help me break the current impasse?
How to balance passion and rationality?

reversed.affirmation: Before you want to rush out, give yourself one more look at the road.
reversed.reading:
Before I could see the road clearly, I already wanted to rush to the front. It’s not hard to find that you act without thinking clearly, ignore risks because of passion, or feel that I am too hasty.

If you take one more step before rushing, you will save a lot of regrets. The first thing you can do is slow down and evaluate, think before you act, or admit, "Maybe I need a plan." Don’t continue to rush blindly, refuse to admit mistakes because of pride, or glorify impulse into courage.

Courage is not about rushing forward blindly, but about knowing when to slow down.
questions: Am I being too impulsive and impatient?
Am I too eager for success and reveal my sincerity too early?
Am I too eager for quick success and setting myself up for failure?

donts: Apply sunscreen only to your face

upright.affirmation: Be yourself, don’t wait for anyone to nod
upright.reading:
The Queen of Wands symbolizes confidence, charm and independence - her light does not need anyone's permission and shines naturally. Now, shine your light.

Maybe feel particularly confident, want to express your true self, or realize "I can be myself." This is a good time to showcase your talents, express your ideas honestly, or infect others with your enthusiasm. Skip hiding your light because you are modest, worrying about being judged, or feeling confident is arrogant.

You deserve to be seen. The real you is the most attractive.

What kind of career can make me feel self-identified?

reversed.reading:
When I look in the mirror, I always feel like nothing is good enough about me. These days you are doubting yourself, feeling unattractive, or afraid of showing your true self.

When you are not confident, you should also be patient with yourself. Today you might as well ask yourself "What makes me lose my confidence?", do something that makes you feel powerful, or seek encouragement from others. Don't deny yourself because of lack of confidence, cover up your insecurities with busyness, or feel like "I'll never be good enough."

The confidence will slowly come back. You were good, you just forgot about it temporarily.
questions: Did my competitiveness hurt the other person?
Do I care too much about other people's opinions?
Am I being overly controlling or aggressive?

The King of Wands symbolizes leadership, vision and control - he guides others in a common direction with clarity of purpose and charisma. Now, it's time to be a leader.

Maybe need to provide direction for your team, make important decisions, or inspire others with your vision. This is a good time to demonstrate leadership, articulate goals, or take action on a long-term vision. Skip holding back due to fear of responsibility, being too authoritarian and not listening to opinions, or mistaking control for leadership.

True leadership is service. Use your vision to guide others, not dictate.
questions: How can I promote this relationship?
Is he worthy of my trust?
How can I develop the courage to strategize?

reversed.affirmation: It doesn't matter if you leave some things to others
reversed.reading:
When you try to control everything, things tend to get messed up more easily. Right now you're being dictatorial, feeling out of control, or realizing there may be something wrong with my approach.

Relax a little bit and listen to what others are doing. Start by listening to others, reevaluating your leadership style, or admitting, "I need help too." Don’t continue to use authority to suppress, overreact because you are out of control, or put all the responsibility on others.

Only if you are willing to listen can you really lead people to move forward.
questions: Am I being overly controlling?
Should I continue to accept cold violence in relationships?
Does my leadership style need to be adjusted?

upright.affirmation: Small opportunities are worth taking a closer look at
upright.reading:
The Ace of Pentacles symbolizes new opportunities, material beginnings, and tangible results—the earth turning your will into visible reality. At this moment, new opportunities are beckoning to you.

You might encounter a new job opportunity, start a project that brings in income, or see your efforts begin to bear tangible results. Today, seize an opportunity in front of you, make practical plans, or take the first step toward a goal. Skip being afraid to start because of perfectionism, wanting to stop doing it, or feeling like the chance is too small to be worth it.

Every big achievement starts with a small opportunity. Grab it and nurture it.
questions: Can a relationship last longer based on material security?
How should I seize this opportunity with great potential?
How should I plan for a windfall?

reversed.affirmation: It’s not a pity to let go of inappropriate opportunities
reversed.reading:
What looks like an opportunity may also hide an unstable side. During this period, you find problems with an opportunity, plan is unrealistic, or realize that this is not what I want.

Take another look at this opportunity and don't rush to place your bet. Start with small things like checking the feasibility of your plan, acknowledging that this opportunity might not be right, or letting go of unrealistic expectations. Stop giving up on opportunities out of frustration, forcing plans that are obviously questionable, or refusing to admit mistakes.

Not all opportunities are worth pursuing. Re-evaluate and find what’s truly a good fit.
questions: Is this opportunity really right for me?
Should I be more sober when faced with feelings that lack material foundation?
How should I stop my losses gracefully?
dos: Go out and bask in the sun

upright.affirmation: No matter how many things there are, they can be sorted out one by one.
upright.reading:
The Two of Pentacles symbolizes a flexible balance between multiple priorities—stability is not about standing still, but finding rhythm in flow. At this moment, you need to find a balance between multiple priorities.

Maybe need to juggle multiple things at once, balance work and life, or respond to changing situations. This is a good time to be flexible, prioritize what's important, or learn to say no to conserve energy. Skip overcommitting, becoming anxious about being out of balance, or refusing to adjust your priorities.

Balance is not static, but adjustment in change. Stay flexible and you can handle it.
questions: How do you take into account each other's emotional needs while being busy at work?
How should I allocate my energy to win in the workplace?
How to find opportunities for growth in changes?

reversed.affirmation: If you have endless things to do, you don’t have to put all the pressure on yourself.
reversed.reading:
If you have too many balls in your hands at the same time, it is inevitable that a few will drop. This is where you take on too much, focus on one thing at the expense of the other, or feel like everything is spiraling out of control.

Reduce the number of things you are doing and leave some space. This is a better time to cut back on commitments, reprioritize, or admit that I need to let go of some. Try not to hold on, feel too guilty to say no, or feel that the imbalance is temporary.

Regain your balance. Some things can wait, and some things can not be done.
questions: Do relationships and life put too much pressure on me?
What do I need to let go of?
How to re-establish priorities in life?

upright.affirmation: When doing things with others, feel free to lend a helping hand
upright.reading:
The Three of Pentacles symbolizes teamwork, expertise, and the results of work—when different forces come together to create something truly valuable. At this moment, focus on the team and the profession.

Maybe need to collaborate with others, demonstrate your professional abilities, or work on a project that requires skills. This is a good time to collaborate with a team, learn new skills, or demonstrate your professionalism. Skip working alone, refusing help from others, or feeling unprofessional.

Cooperation creates greater results. Believe in your professionalism and trust your team.
questions: How can we make our relationship stronger by planning the future together?
Faced with this highly collaborative project, how should I demonstrate my professionalism?
How can my professional abilities be better demonstrated?

reversed.affirmation: When cooperation doesn’t go well, it’s easier to talk things over
reversed.reading:
Everyone is obviously doing the same thing, but they don't step in the same step. Judging from the reaction, you don't get along with your colleagues, your skills don't match, or you feel the quality of your work has declined.

Make the division of labor and expectations clear so that cooperation can continue. Today can start with communication to resolve differences, reallocate tasks, or admit that we need to adjust. Stop being reluctant to cooperate, blaming everyone else for everything, or refusing to seek improvement.

Good collaboration requires adjustments. Identify the problem and realign.
questions: Is this lack of in-depth communication between us destined to not go far?
Faced with the other party's perfunctory details, shouldn't I stop hypnotizing myself?
How can I save myself from this chaos within the team where everyone is doing their own thing and lacking standards?

upright.affirmation: Having a little extra money on hand will make you feel more at ease
upright.reading:
The Four of Pentacles symbolizes the protection of security - it reminds us that holding on too tightly can sometimes become another form of restraint. At this moment, you may be seeking a sense of security.

Maybe want to protect what you have, save money, or avoid taking risks. Today, save for the future, build a stable foundation, or protect important resources. Skip losing opportunities due to being too protective of money, not daring to invest because of fear, or using material things to replace emotional security.

A sense of security is good, but don't let it become a prison. Stay steady while staying open.
questions: Has my extremely insecure desire to control made him feel depressed?
How do I break the ice in this stable relationship?
Should I consider a more conservative savings option?

reversed.affirmation: There is no need to hold on to everything, just give it away a little bit.
reversed.reading:
Reluctant to throw away, reluctant to give, and in the end, I tightened my grip too much. In life, you are hoarding, over-controlling, or stingy out of fear.

Only when you relax your hands will you know what you really need. First try to ask yourself how much I really need, share and give appropriately, or redefine security. There’s no need to continue to hold on to something, be too afraid to spend money, or fill an emotional void with material things.

If you loosen your grip a little, there will be room for life.
questions: Am I too attached to material things?
Am I so afraid of losing that I push away the people who love me?
How to find security from within?
dos: Change new sheets and quilt covers

upright.affirmation: When you can’t hold it any longer, it’s okay to let the people around you know.
upright.reading:
The Five of Pentacles symbolizes difficult times and times for help—it reminds us that even in the toughest of times, help is often close at hand. Maybe be facing material or health difficulties at this time.

Maybe feel deprived, physically unwell, or experience financial stress. Today, ask for help, receive support, or remember that this is only temporary. Skip not asking for help out of pride, feeling unworthy of help, or falling into despair.

Difficulties are temporary. Looking back, help is just behind that door.
questions: How do I reach out to the resources around me for help?
How can we support each other out of the current predicament?
How to get through this difficult time?

reversed.affirmation: You made it through. Come back to yourself.
reversed.reading:
The difficult period was almost over, and some help began to appear around me. Slowly, you get out of trouble, get help, or see hope.

A little improvement is worth your attention. Give yourself some time to be grateful for the help you have received, continue to work hard to improve, or help others in need. Remember not to assume that improvement is a fluke, repeat the patterns that led to trouble, or forget about the people who helped you.

The road still has to be walked slowly, but you are no longer going through it alone.
questions: Have I left my predicament and can enjoy happiness in peace?
Should I take the initiative to leave the person who belittles me?
How to avoid getting into trouble again?

upright.affirmation: When you help others, you will also feel at ease
upright.reading:
The Six of Pentacles symbolizes generosity, fairness, and giving—true abundance lies in the ability to give and receive fluidly. In this moment, focus on the balance of giving and receiving.

Maybe need to help others, share resources, or accept kindness from others. This is a time to give generously, treat others fairly, or be grateful for what you receive. Skip giving too much and neglecting yourself, giving with strings attached, or refusing to accept help.

Giving and receiving are flows of love. Stay balanced and generosity will cycle back.
questions: How should I repay his/her material gifts?
How to balance giving and receiving?
How do I accept the generosity of others?

reversed.affirmation: You are willing to help, but you must respect your own boundaries.

After helping again and again, the score in my heart may no longer be peaceful. In my heart, I am over-giving, helping with conditions, or feeling used.

Before giving it away, ask yourself if you will feel wronged. Next, start by reevaluating how you give, establishing boundaries, or acknowledging that some giving is unhealthy. Don’t continue to be taken advantage of, guilt overgive, or stop giving altogether.

Healthy giving goes both ways. Find your balance again.
questions: Is my giving healthy?
How should I get out of the face of 'central air conditioning'?
Is there unfair distribution in my environment?

upright.affirmation: Don’t rush to deny yourself when you don’t see the results.
upright.reading:

Maybe be waiting for results, assessing progress, or considering whether it's time to change course. This is a good time to wait, evaluate current results, or decide if a change of strategy is needed. Skip giving up, becoming overly anxious, or refusing to change course because you don’t see immediate results.

Results take time. Assess the current situation and decide on next steps.
questions: What results will my efforts bring me?
